why_this_was_needed: every defect root found in this contract was invisible to my helper-level tests and obvious from the entry point: Deadline.bounded() was correct while the dispatch path never called it; child_confirmed_stopped was recorded while the files were read anyway; the receipt forwarded the old byte counter beside the new measured hash; a broken barrier still sent both requests. A helper tested in isolation says nothing about whether anything calls it.
